artboards.title: D · Name as the hero (Add a place)

annotations.text:
TikTok wait — three animated directions (they loop; the real wait is ~20s).
A · Route W: the logo's route draws itself while a little video rides it; each stop lights a stage. Ties the wait to the new icon.
B · Scan the video: a teal line scans the clip, the words it read peel off as chips, then fold into a pin that drops. Shows what the app is actually doing.
C · Search the map: a radar sweep over the city, candidate spots blink up, the match drops in with 'Found it'. Most playful; says least about the video.

Add a place — the name gets the stage, the tags get colour. Tag colours follow the app's category pins: food orange, outdoors green, culture violet, shopping pink.
D · Name as the hero: a big name card rises out of the map (editable via the pencil); tags are tinted chips by kind, picked ones fill solid.
E · Colour card: the name sits on a block in its kind's colour with a map inset; tags become icon tiles you tap on and off.
Sample place and address; mix and match any wait with any Add-place direction.
